maintenance_led.reason: Sells oilfield chemicals and additives for new well completions and drilling, consumed in operation, not servicing installed equipment.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are private oil and gas operators and oilfield service companies.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly by selling its own chemistry and data products, not through a steady stream of acquisitions.

mission_critical.reason: Mostly oilfield chemicals such as friction reducers and additives, which operators can re-source from other suppliers.

notes: Tailored Complex Nano-Fluid designs may raise switching costs somewhat, but most sales are chemicals.
